title: A member added at the end of a mapping goes after the indented comment its last entry owns
notes: The comment line is indented more than the key `k`, so it belongs to the entry `k` (docs/edit-semantics.md, Comments: a comment line directly after an entry and indented more than its key belongs to that entry). A member added at the end of the mapping goes after the whole entry, so after that comment; the exception is only for comments before a document marker (`edit/add-before-an-indented-comment-before-a-document-marker`). The exact bytes rest on the kit convention for comment ownership.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend put the new member between the entry and its comment; the pure backend wrote the expected bytes.
